blocks.text: Where Tsawwassen Penthouse Condos Are Located

parts.t: Tsawwassen has a low-rise coastal skyline, so most penthouses sit on the top level of four-to-six-storey buildings in two main pockets:

Clustered around 56 Street, 12 Avenue, and the Tsawwassen Town Centre Mall area. Top-floor units here appeal to downsizers who want flat, walkable access to groceries, medical clinics, cafes, and transit on freehold strata land.

Includes the golf-course buildings at Tsawwassen Springs (concrete and wood-frame mid-rises overlooking the fairways and North Shore mountains) as well as newer master-planned condo communities near Tsawwassen Mills and Tsawwassen Shores.

blocks.text: What to Check Before Buying a Tsawwassen Penthouse

parts.t: Top-floor living gives you vaulted or over-height ceilings, quiet above you, and wide views across the golf course, mountains, or Strait of Georgia—but several Tsawwassen-specific details belong on your due-diligence checklist:

In Tsawwassen, buildings in Town Centre are typically freehold strata under the City of Delta, whereas communities in Tsawwassen North near Tsawwassen Mills sit on Tsawwassen First Nation (TFN) leasehold land. Financing rules, property transfer tax rules, and long-term resale comparisons differ between freehold and prepaid 99-year leasehold properties, so confirm the tenure on the listing before you write.
Coastal weather, roof membranes, and skylights:

Tsawwassen is sunnier than much of Metro Vancouver, but coastal wind happens year-round. Review the depreciation report and council minutes for roof membrane age, parapet flashing maintenance, and window or skylight seals.
Limited Common Property (LCP) decks and terraces:
Check the strata plan to confirm the boundaries of your balcony or wraparound terrace, and read the bylaws for rules on gas heaters, barbecues, planters, and awning or shade installations.

Because BC strata fees scale with interior square footage on the strata plan, a spacious two-bedroom-plus-den penthouse pays a larger share of the operating budget and any special levy than smaller suites on lower floors.

Verify on the Form B Information Certificate how many underground stalls and storage lockers are assigned to the unit and whether they are Limited Common Property or separate leasehold/license assignments.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Tsawwassen Penthouses
1. What listings appear on this Tsawwassen penthouses page?

parts.t: It excludes lower-floor apartments and townhomes so you can focus specifically on top-floor condo residences.

blocks.text: 2. Where are most penthouse condos located in Tsawwassen?

parts.t: Tsawwassen penthouses are concentrated in two areas: Tsawwassen Central around 56 Street and the Town Centre (walkable low- and mid-rise buildings), and Tsawwassen North—including resort-style golf course buildings at Tsawwassen Springs and newer mid-rise developments near Tsawwassen Mills.

blocks.text: 3. Are some Tsawwassen penthouses on Tsawwassen First Nation leasehold land?

parts.t: Yes. Developments in Tsawwassen North near Tsawwassen Mills and Tsawwassen Shores sit on Tsawwassen First Nation (TFN) leasehold land, while buildings in Tsawwassen Town Centre and Tsawwassen Springs include freehold strata and leasehold options. Always check the MLS® Land Tenure field and lease terms before making an offer.

blocks.text: 4. Who looks after the roof and deck membrane on a Tsawwassen penthouse?

parts.t: Large penthouse decks and terraces are usually designated Limited Common Property (LCP) on the strata plan. In most stratas, the strata corporation maintains the structural roof and waterproofing membrane while the owner handles routine surface cleaning, but you should confirm the exact wording in the strata bylaws.

blocks.text: 5. Why do penthouse units have higher monthly strata fees?

parts.t: Under BC's Strata Property Act, monthly strata fees and special levies are divided by unit entitlement, which is based on interior square footage on the strata plan. Because top-floor penthouses are typically larger than standard suites in the same building, their monthly share of the budget is proportionally higher.

blocks.text: 6. Do Tsawwassen penthouses come with air conditioning and two parking stalls?

parts.t: Many newer top-floor suites at Tsawwassen Springs and in recent Town Centre mid-rises include heat-pump cooling and two underground stalls, while older low-rise buildings in Central Tsawwassen may not have built-in cooling. Check the Form B Information Certificate and strata plan to verify parking stall and locker assignments.

blocks.text: 7. Can you alert me to top-floor Tsawwassen condos that aren't tagged Penthouse?

parts.t: Yes. Some agents list top-floor apartments as 'Upper Unit' rather than ticking the Penthouse style box on MLS®. Reach out with your preferred buildings or budget and I will set up a direct MLS® alert that catches every top-floor listing in Tsawwassen.
